title: A Mouse in the House
lines: Nita and her mom have a small house.
She keeps a jar of seeds by the window.
Each day she feeds the birds in the yard.
One day she found seeds on the floor.
Who had spilled them? Nita looked all over.
Then she saw a brown mouse by the bin.
The mouse was eating her bird seeds!
Nita bent down to catch it in her hands.
But the mouse was too quick. It ran off.
Nita did not shout. She got a box.
She set it down with a bit of bread.
Then she sat still and waited a long time.
At last the mouse came out again.
It went in the box to get the bread.
Nita had found a way to catch it!
She and Mom took the box out to the yard.
They let the mouse go by the flower bed.
It sat on the ground and looked up.
Now the mouse is safe, and the house is too.

questions.ask: What did Nita find on the floor that made her look?
questions.listenFor: Seeds. That is the clue that sent her looking.

questions.ask: What did Nita try first, and did it work?
questions.listenFor: She bent down to catch it in her hands. No — it was too quick.

questions.ask: Do you think the mouse will come back in? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story.
